technical.summary: Strong momentum and breakout signals with 15x volume spike and new highs, but overbought conditions across multiple oscillators and lack of long-term trend confirmation limit entry probability.

fundamental.summary: WEC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 64 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market fear (43/100) presents mild contrarian opportunity, but absence of recent news data and stale congressional trades (189+ days) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (238.7) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility; utilities defensive positioning offers limited offset to systemic risk environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: 15x volume spike with new 20-day highs and rising RSI(9) signal genuine momentum breakout in a fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 71.76/75.18, Stoch 88.12), inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (238.7), no long-term trend confirmation, and zero fundamental/insider support create a classic bull-trap setup into macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: 15x volume spike and new 20-day highs present technical momentum, but overbought oscillators (RSI 71.76/75.18, Stoch 88.12) combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels (238.7) create a classic bull-trap setup with unfavorable macro backdrop.
decision.primary_risk: Overbought conditions into NFP event in 2 days and inverted yield curve recession signal; price likely to mean-revert sharply as momentum exhausts in crisis-level volatility environment.
